name: Psychic Phenomena
description: Psychic phenomena (psi) are alleged mental abilities — telepathy, clairvoyance, precognition, and psychokinesis — that operate outside known sensory channels and physical mechanisms. The mainstream scientific community classifies the field as pseudoscience.

aliases.name: Psi
aliases.meaning: Greek letter ψ used as the field's umbrella term

aliases.name: Anomalous cognition / anomalous perturbation
aliases.meaning: Stargate-era and later technical terms for psi

origin: Belief in psi is documented across most cultures and historical periods. Laboratory study has been concentrated in the United States, the United Kingdom, Western Europe, and the former Soviet Union.
